value.rationale: The exact mixed covariance is a natural age-stratified global/local network observable, distinguished from marginal degree and leaf distributions. Its complete finite product form, unique time crossing, and sharp universal birth-age fraction 1/9 reveal opposite dependence regimes for old and young vertices in one growth model. It has a plausible interpretive use for age-selective hubs and terminal network structure; it is not an arbitrary cutoff or table recomputation.
